description: Find search_jobs filters and job fields matching keywords, with type and a short description. Pass words such as ["pay", "remote"]; no keywords lists everything. kind is filter, option (sort, a search_jobs argument beside filters) or field (postings[].x is a posting property). A field state object says whether the source published the value (known), Atlas derived it, the source omitted it, or extraction failed.
name: list_fields
title: List job fields and filters
